_readme: Edit this file to change the studio details and the weekly class timetable. Times are 24h (HH:MM) in the studio timezone. Prices are in the main currency unit (e.g. 30 = 30 SAR). Each class needs a unique 'key' — if you change a class's time, give it a new key so existing bookings are not affected.

studio.name: Pilates w Basma
studio.tagline: Ready to move and sculpt? Come as you are and leave feeling stronger, more energized, and a little more connected to your body.
studio.about: Pilates classes at KAUST for women. Spots are limited, so reserve yours in one of the upcoming classes below.
